# community

Public-facing community docs and contribution material.

## Purpose

- Contribution guidance and aggregation reports.

## Ownership

- Community-facing content.

## Local Contracts

- Community docs must not contain secrets or internal implementation details not suitable for public disclosure.

## Work Guidance

- Keep tone operator-friendly; link back to root docs.

## Verification

- Review before publishing externally.
